verses.original: μὴ ἐπιπλήξῃς Πρεσβυτέρῳ ἀλλὰ παρακάλει ὡς πατέρα νεωτέρους ὡς ἀδελφούς
verses.transliteration: mē epiplēxēs Presbyterō alla parakalei hōs patera neōterous hōs adelphous
verses.literal: {Do} not rebuke an older man but appeal to [him] as to a father [Treat] younger [men] as brothers

verses.original: πρεσβυτέρας ὡς μητέρας νεωτέρας ὡς ἀδελφὰς ἐν πάσῃ ἁγνείᾳ
verses.transliteration: presbyteras hōs mēteras neōteras hōs adelphas en pasē hagneia
verses.literal: older [women] as mothers [and] younger [women] as sisters with absolute purity

verses.original: τίμα Χήρας τὰς ὄντως χήρας
verses.transliteration: tima Chēras tas ontōs chēras
verses.literal: Honor [the] widows who [are] truly widows

verses.original: δέ εἰ τις χήρα ἔχει τέκνα ἢ ἔκγονα μανθανέτωσαν πρῶτον εὐσεβεῖν τὸν ἴδιον οἶκον καὶ ἀποδιδόναι ἀμοιβὰς τοῖς προγόνοις γάρ τοῦτο ἐστιν ἀπόδεκτον ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: de ei tis chēra echei tekna ē ekgona manthanetōsan prōton eusebein ton idion oikon kai apodidonai amoibas tois progonois gar touto estin apodekton enōpion tou Theou
verses.literal: But if a widow has children or grandchildren they must first learn . . . to show godliness to [their] own family and repay . . . [their] parents for this is pleasing in the sight of - God

verses.original: δὲ Ἡ ὄντως χήρα καὶ μεμονωμένη ἤλπικεν ἐπὶ Θεὸν καὶ προσμένει νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας ταῖς δεήσεσιν καὶ ταῖς προσευχαῖς
verses.transliteration: de Hē ontōs chēra kai memonōmenē ēlpiken epi Theon kai prosmenei nyktos kai hēmeras tais deēsesin kai tais proseuchais
verses.literal: - [The widow] who [is] truly [in need] and left all alone puts [her] hope in God and continues night and day in [her] petitions and - prayers

verses.original: δὲ ἡ σπαταλῶσα τέθνηκεν ζῶσα
verses.transliteration: de hē spatalōsa tethnēken zōsa
verses.literal: But she who lives for pleasure is dead [even while she] is still alive

verses.original: Καὶ παράγγελλε ταῦτα ἵνα ὦσιν ἀνεπίλημπτοι
verses.transliteration: Kai parangelle tauta hina ōsin anepilēmptoi
verses.literal: - Give these instructions [to the believers] . . . so that they will be above reproach

verses.original: δέ εἰ τις οὐ προνοεῖ τῶν ἰδίων καὶ μάλιστα οἰκείων ἤρνηται τὴν πίστιν καὶ ἔστιν χείρων ἀπίστου
verses.transliteration: de ei tis ou pronoei tōn idiōn kai malista oikeiōn ērnētai tēn pistin kai estin cheirōn apistou
verses.literal: - If anyone vvv does not provide for [his] own and especially [his own] household he has denied the faith and is worse than an unbeliever

verses.original: Χήρα καταλεγέσθω γεγονυῖα μὴ ἔλαττον ἑξήκοντα ἐτῶν γυνή ἑνὸς ἀνδρὸς
verses.transliteration: Chēra katalegesthō gegonuia mē elatton hexēkonta etōn gynē henos andros
verses.literal: A widow should be enrolled if she is vvv [at least] sixty years [old] faithful . . . to her husband

verses.original: μαρτυρουμένη ἐν καλοῖς ἔργοις εἰ ἐτεκνοτρόφησεν εἰ ἐξενοδόχησεν εἰ ἔνιψεν πόδας ἁγίων εἰ ἐπήρκεσεν θλιβομένοις εἰ ἐπηκολούθησεν παντὶ ἀγαθῷ ἔργῳ
verses.transliteration: martyroumenē en kalois ergois ei eteknotrophēsen ei exenodochēsen ei enipsen podas hagiōn ei epērkesen thlibomenois ei epēkolouthēsen panti agathō ergō
verses.literal: [and] well known for good deeds [such as] bringing up children - entertaining strangers - washing [the] feet of the saints - imparting relief to the afflicted [and] devoting herself to every good work

verses.original: δὲ παραιτοῦ Νεωτέρας χήρας γὰρ ὅταν καταστρηνιάσωσιν τοῦ Χριστοῦ θέλουσιν γαμεῖν
verses.transliteration: de paraitou Neōteras chēras gar hotan katastrēniasōsin tou Christou thelousin gamein
verses.literal: But refuse [to enroll] younger widows For when their passions draw them away - from Christ they will want to marry

verses.original: ἔχουσαι κρίμα ὅτι ἠθέτησαν τὴν πρώτην πίστιν
verses.transliteration: echousai krima hoti ēthetēsan tēn prōtēn pistin
verses.literal: [and thus] will incur judgment because they are setting aside [their] first faith

verses.original: δὲ ἅμα καὶ μανθάνουσιν ἀργαὶ περιερχόμεναι τὰς οἰκίας δὲ οὐ μόνον ἀργαὶ ἀλλὰ καὶ φλύαροι καὶ περίεργοι λαλοῦσαι τὰ δέοντα μὴ
verses.transliteration: de hama kai manthanousin argai perierchomenai tas oikias de ou monon argai alla kai phlyaroi kai periergoi lalousai ta deonta mē
verses.literal: - At the same time vvv they will also learn [to be] idle going from - house to house and {being} not only idle but also gossips and busybodies discussing things they should not [ mention ]

verses.original: οὖν Βούλομαι νεωτέρας γαμεῖν τεκνογονεῖν οἰκοδεσποτεῖν διδόναι μηδεμίαν τῷ ἀντικειμένῳ ἀφορμὴν χάριν λοιδορίας
verses.transliteration: oun Boulomai neōteras gamein teknogonein oikodespotein didonai mēdemian tō antikeimenō aphormēn charin loidorias
verses.literal: So I advise [the] younger [widows] to marry have children [and] manage their households denying . . . the adversary occasion for slander

verses.original: γάρ τινες ἤδη ἐξετράπησαν ὀπίσω τοῦ Σατανᾶ
verses.transliteration: gar tines ēdē exetrapēsan opisō tou Satana
verses.literal: For some vvv have already turned aside to follow - Satan

verses.original: Εἴ τις πιστὴ ἔχει χήρας ἐπαρκείτω αὐταῖς καὶ μὴ ἡ ἐκκλησία βαρείσθω ἵνα ἐπαρκέσῃ ταῖς χήραις ὄντως
verses.transliteration: Ei tis pistē echei chēras eparkeitō autais kai mē hē ekklēsia bareisthō hina eparkesē tais chērais ontōs
verses.literal: If any believing [woman] has [dependent] widows she must assist them and not {allow} the church to be burdened so that it can help the widows [who are] truly [ in need ]

verses.original: Οἱ πρεσβύτεροι προεστῶτες καλῶς ἀξιούσθωσαν διπλῆς τιμῆς μάλιστα οἱ κοπιῶντες ἐν λόγῳ καὶ διδασκαλίᾳ
verses.transliteration: Hoi presbyteroi proestōtes kalōs axiousthōsan diplēs timēs malista hoi kopiōntes en logō kai didaskalia
verses.literal: - Elders who lead effectively are worthy of double honor especially those who work hard at preaching and teaching

verses.original: γὰρ ἡ γραφή λέγει οὐ φιμώσεις Βοῦν ἀλοῶντα καί ὁ ἐργάτης Ἄξιος τοῦ αὐτοῦ μισθοῦ
verses.transliteration: gar hē graphē legei ou phimōseis Boun aloōnta kai ho ergatēs Axios tou autou misthou
verses.literal: For the Scripture says vvv Do not muzzle an ox while it is treading out the grain and The worker [is] worthy of his wages

verses.original: μὴ παραδέχου κατηγορίαν Κατὰ πρεσβυτέρου ἐκτὸς εἰ μὴ ἐπὶ δύο ἢ τριῶν μαρτύρων
verses.transliteration: mē paradechou katēgorian Kata presbyterou ektos ei mē epi dyo ē triōn martyrōn
verses.literal: {Do} not entertain an accusation against an elder except . . . . . . on [the testimony of] two or three witnesses

verses.original: δὲ Τοὺς ἁμαρτάνοντας ἔλεγχε ἐνώπιον πάντων ἵνα καὶ οἱ λοιποὶ ἔχωσιν φόβον
verses.transliteration: de Tous hamartanontas elenche enōpion pantōn hina kai hoi loipoi echōsin phobon
verses.literal: But those who persist in sin should be rebuked in front of everyone so that - the others will stand in fear [of sin]

verses.original: Διαμαρτύρομαι ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ καὶ τῶν ἐκλεκτῶν ἀγγέλων ἵνα φυλάξῃς ταῦτα χωρὶς προκρίματος ποιῶν μηδὲν κατὰ πρόσκλισιν
verses.transliteration: Diamartyromai enōpion tou Theou kai Christou Iēsou kai tōn eklektōn angelōn hina phylaxēs tauta chōris prokrimatos poiōn mēden kata prosklisin
verses.literal: I solemnly charge [you] before - God and Christ Jesus and the elect angels to maintain these [principles] without bias [and] to do nothing out of partiality

verses.original: ταχέως μηδενὶ ἐπιτίθει Χεῖρας μηδὲ κοινώνει ἁμαρτίαις ἀλλοτρίαις τήρει σεαυτὸν ἁγνὸν
verses.transliteration: tacheōs mēdeni epitithei Cheiras mēde koinōnei hamartiais allotriais tērei seauton hagnon
verses.literal: Do not be too quick . . . in the laying on of hands [and thereby] share in [the] sins of others Keep yourself pure

verses.original: Μηκέτι ὑδροπότει χρῶ ὀλίγῳ οἴνῳ ἀλλὰ διὰ τὸν στόμαχον καὶ σου πυκνάς τὰς ἀσθενείας
verses.transliteration: Mēketi hydropotei chrō oligō oinō alla dia ton stomachon kai sou pyknas tas astheneias
verses.literal: vvv Stop drinking [only] water [and] use a little wine instead because of [your] stomach and your frequent - ailments

verses.original: αἱ ἁμαρτίαι Τινῶν ἀνθρώπων εἰσιν πρόδηλοί προάγουσαι εἰς κρίσιν δὲ τισὶν καὶ ἐπακολουθοῦσιν
verses.transliteration: hai hamartiai Tinōn anthrōpōn eisin prodēloi proagousai eis krisin de tisin kai epakolouthousin
verses.literal: The sins of some men are obvious going ahead of [them] to judgment but [the sins] of others vvv do [not] surface until later

verses.original: ὡσαύτως καὶ τὰ καλὰ τὰ ἔργα πρόδηλα καὶ τὰ ἔχοντα ἄλλως οὐ δύνανται κρυβῆναι
verses.transliteration: hōsautōs kai ta kala ta erga prodēla kai ta echonta allōs ou dynantai krybēnai
verses.literal: In the same way . . . - good - deeds [are] obvious and even the [ones that] are [inconspicuous] vvv cannot remain hidden
